{{Quote|I'll spare you the details. The gist is that one of us needs to go to sector police subpost one eighty-six to bail out a certain Sullustan named Den Dhur. Unless&ndash;and this is the course of action I personally recommend&ndash;you would rather he remain in custody.|[[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]] to Jax Pavan|<ref name="CNII" />}}
'''Sector Police Subpost 186''' was a [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police]] station located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was heavily fortified, [[Window/Legends|windowless]], and contained office space and holding [[Prison/Legends|cells]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Den Dhur]] was briefly held at Subpost 186 after he was arrested for impersonating a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]]. Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Private investigator/Legends|private investigator]] [[Jax Pavan]] went to the station to fill out the paperwork necessary to have Dhur released.<ref name="CNII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sector Police Subpost 186 first appeared in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', which was published on [[August 26]], [[2008]] and written by [[Michael Reaves]].
